definition: {HoldPattern[solveFresnel[wIn_List, wR_List, wT_List, unknowns_]] :> Module[{getH, sol, equ, EMtop, EMbot, HMtop, HMbot, B, M}, getH[wav_] := Cross[Key[k][wav], Key[EE][wav]]/(Key[ω][wav]*μ0); EMtop = Total[(Key[EE][#1] & ) /@ Flatten[{wIn, wR}]]; EMbot = Total[(Key[EE][#1] & ) /@ Flatten[wT]]; HMtop = Total[(getH[#1] & ) /@ Flatten[{wIn, wR}]]; HMbot = Total[(getH[#1] & ) /@ Flatten[wT]]; If[flagLinearSolve, equ = {EMtop[[1]] - EMbot[[1]] == 0, HMtop[[1]] - HMbot[[1]] == 0, EMtop[[2]] - EMbot[[2]] == 0, HMtop[[2]] - HMbot[[2]] == 0}; {B, M} = Normal[CoefficientArrays[equ, unknowns]]; sol = Thread[unknowns -> LinearSolve[M, B]]; , equ = {EMtop[[1 ;; 2]] == EMbot[[1 ;; 2]], HMtop[[1 ;; 2]] == HMbot[[1 ;; 2]]}; equ = Flatten[Simplify[Thread /@ equ]]; Quiet[If[flagNSolve, sol = NSolve[equ, unknowns], sol = Solve[equ, unknowns]]]; If[sol === {}, Print["sol is {} in solveFresnel! "]; sol = Thread[{unknowns -> ConstantArray[0., Length[unknowns]]}], sol = sol[[1]]]; ]; wR = wR /. sol; wT = wT /. sol; ]}

", (#1[k] & ) /@ wMed[[nM]]]]; If[debug, Print["Here!!! equ
", MatrixForm[Chop[Simplify[Flatten[Thread /@ equ] /. {Δδ -> 0}]]]]]; If[flagLinearSolve, {B, M} = Normal[CoefficientArrays[equ, unknowns]]; sol = Thread[unknowns -> LinearSolve[M, B]]; , Quiet[If[flagNSolve, sol = NSolve[equ, unknowns], sol = Solve[equ, unknowns]]]; If[Length[sol] == 0, Print["sol is {} in solveFresnelN!"]; sol = Thread[unknowns -> ConstantArray[0., Length[unknowns]]], sol = sol[[1]]]; ]; If[debug, Print["sol
", MatrixForm[Simplify[sol]]]]; wAir = wAir /. sol; wSub = wSub /. sol; wMed = wMed /. sol; ]}
